summary.text: Chad Ingels, a Republican, represents District 68 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Ingels as serving a third term.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes Ingels as a farmer, founder of ClearWater Ag Strategies, LLC, and former watershed specialist for Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, and lists service as former chairman of the Iowa Environmental Protection Commission and as a 2018 candidate for Iowa Secretary of Agriculture.
It lists a B.S. in horticulture (1991) and an M.A. in professional agriculture (2013) from Iowa State University, and says Ingels was born in 1968 in Oelwein and lives near Randalia.
